code: import axios from"axios";const HTTP=axios.create({baseURL:"http://127.0.0.1:8000/api"});export const fetchAlerts=async(limit=20)=>{const res=await HTTP.get("/alerts",{params:{limit}});return res.data;};export const fetchBlockedIPs=async()=>{const res=await HTTP.get("/blocked-ips");return res.data.blocked_ips||[];};export const blockIP=async ip=>{const res=await HTTP.post("/block-ip",{ip});return res.data;};export const unblockIP=async ip=>{const res=await HTTP.post("/unblock-ip",{ip});return res.data;};export const connectWs=onMessage=>{const ws=new WebSocket("ws://localhost:8000/ws/alerts");ws.onmessage=e=>onMessage(JSON.parse(e.data));ws.onclose=()=>console.warn("Alert WS closed");return ws;};export default{fetchAlerts,connectWs};
